subject: Medford High School Revised Site Layout
overview: The advisory team met to review and discuss key elements of the Medford High School building project. The team voted to recommend the updated site layout featuring distributed parking and a rotated field to the School Building Committee.

items.title: Meeting Introduction and Agenda Review
items.summary: Matt Rice opened the fourth meeting of the advisory team to review key design updates and establish a recommendation for the School Building Committee.

items.title: Parking Program Review
items.summary: Laura Swan presented the 477-space parking program, noting that Ken has the authority to modify the baseline count if school program sizes change.

items.title: Updated Site Layout Recommendation
items.summary: The advisory team voted to recommend proceeding with the updated site layout, which features a rotated field, distributed parking, and dual drop-off loops.

items.title: Track and Field Plans
items.summary: The design team presented plans for the synthetic turf track and field, including bleachers, a concession building, and initial clearance from the DCR regarding restricted land use.

items.title: ECC Breezeway Concept
items.summary: Matt Rice outlined the proposed ECC Breezeway concept, which creates a pedestrian shortcut, preschool access, and a dedicated entrance for the Curtis Tufts program.

items.title: Call for Assistance Stations
items.summary: Mike Cabral reviewed proposed locations for emergency blue light call for assistance stations across campus parking lots and athletic fields.

items.title: Next Steps and Adjournment
items.summary: The team outlined next steps, including further coordination on site circulation with the district and scheduling a subsequent meeting for early November.
